profile.name: DEBISA DARICHA DABA
profile.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer & Odoo ERP Specialist
profile.tagline: Building scalable web applications, custom Odoo ERP systems, AgriTech platforms, and enterprise solutions since 2025.
profile.about: Passionate Senior Full Stack Software Engineer based in Ethiopia with expertise in full-stack web development, custom Odoo ERP engineering, REST APIs, and digital agriculture platforms. Graduate of Dambi Dollo University, delivering modern software systems since 2025.

projects.title: Job Portal System
projects.description: Comprehensive recruitment & career marketplace platform connecting job seekers and top enterprise employers with instant job matching, posting workflows, and application tracking.
projects.longDescription: The Job Portal System is a modern, end-to-end employment platform engineered to streamline hiring for companies and career growth for job seekers. Features dual portal interfaces for Employers ('Post a Job') and Candidates ('Find Jobs'), multi-role authentication (Applicant, Recruiter, Admin), real-time job searching with category & skill filters, candidate resume management, live application status tracking, and scalable REST APIs supporting high-volume discovery across 100K+ enterprise companies and 180K+ active listings.

projects.title: Odoo ERP Enterprise Solution
projects.description: Customized Odoo ERP enterprise system integrating sales, inventory control, accounting, CRM, and human resource management modules.
projects.longDescription: An end-to-end Odoo ERP solution engineered for organizational operational efficiency. Configured custom Python modules, automated workflow triggers, dynamic business intelligence reporting, and REST API data synchronization.

projects.title: AgriLink Ethiopia
projects.description: Digital agricultural commodity marketplace and live market price intelligence platform empowering farmers across Ethiopia.
projects.longDescription: AgriLink Ethiopia bridges the gap between Ethiopian agricultural producers and regional crop buyers. Features real-time commodity price tracking (Teff, Maize, Coffee, Sesame), direct buyer-seller trading channels, and logistics tracking.

experiences.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
experiences.description: Engineering full-stack web portals, AgriLink Ethiopia, Job Portal System, and custom Odoo ERP module integrations. Graduate of Dambi Dollo University.
highlights: Architected AgriLink Ethiopia digital agriculture marketplace and Job Portal System
Designed custom Odoo ERP workflows and REST APIs for business process automation
